EX12-076#effect#1.reason: MEASURED 2026-08-25 against DCGO scripted-v12 (dcgo_commit 4db6ee409). DCGO aborted: "prompt mismatch: step 23 expected prompt 'SelectPermanentEffect' but DCGO asked 'MultipleSkills'". DCGO raises a simultaneous-trigger stack where we go straight to a target prompt -- i.e. the two engines disagree about how many effects triggered at that point, not about how to answer one. Distinct from the optional-accept family. (Supersedes the 'structurally unmeasurable with the current line vocabulary' recon note, which was never measured.) The line lowers CLEAN sim-side (the corpus is 144/144 green), so this is not an authoring error our own engine can see -- it is a real prompt-SHAPE disagreement between the engines, which is exactly what sim-only cannot catch. Job outcome was `failed` (DCGO aborted mid-line), so no sidecar exists and nothing could be diffed: this stays `unreachable`, NOT `diverged` -- `diverged` requires both engines to have run the line end-to-end and disagreed about STATE.
